module Test.RES.06

import Test.Support exposing NotFound
function fail_on_zero(n: Integer) returns Result<Integer, NotFound>
requires n >= 0
aborts NotFound
is
    if n = 0 then
        return error NotFound
    end if
    return ok n
end fail_on_zero
function unsafe_value(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= 0
is
    let r: Result<Integer, NotFound> = fail_on_zero(n)
    return r.value
end unsafe_value

end Test.RES.06
